svg.text: Meet and connect. Find classmates and friends.
Friendship knows no distance. Rediscover the people who mattered to you.
Welcome to JoinFriends.com, a place to reconnect with friends from school,
university, work and military service — and to make new friends.
Our community helps you find people you once knew, stay in touch,
exchange messages, and arrange meetings with your old friends.
• Former classmates, university friends and colleagues
• People who lived in your town or neighbourhood
• People who served together in the armed forces
